semantics: Bounded Europe PMC exact-name/alias discovery and inspected source records. Hit counts are retrieval observations, not evidence grades. Withholding is a resolved editorial disposition, not proof no literature exists. No new standalone routes are authorized by this record.

candidates.name: Fluetizolam
candidates.disposition: Withhold standalone: rat cortical-culture evidence does not establish human PK, poisoning or withdrawal.

candidates.name: Ethylflualprazolam
candidates.disposition: Withhold standalone: this exact-name screen yielded no indexed record; that is a search limitation, not proof of absence.

candidates.name: Etonitazene
candidates.disposition: Family coverage in nitazene-opioids: historical/preclinical comparator; avoid assigning analogue human casework to etonitazene.

candidates.name: N-pyrrolidino metonitazene
candidates.disposition: Family coverage in nitazene-opioids: receptor and mixed five-analogue forensic dataset; no isolated human potency or withdrawal timeline.

candidates.name: N-desethyl isotonitazene
candidates.disposition: Family coverage in nitazene-opioids: Birmingham clinical series separates presentations from patients and acknowledges extensive polydrug exposure.

candidates.name: Chlorphine

candidates.name: Spirochlorphine
